company_name: Beijing Opton Optical Technology Co., Ltd
semiconductor_relevance: High — The company provides critical optical components and systems for photolithography and inspection processes in semiconductor fabrication.
summary: Beijing Opton Optical Technology Co., Ltd develops and produces advanced optical technologies that are essential for semiconductor manufacturing. Their high-precision optical components and systems are used in photolithography and inspection, collaborating with leading institutions and industry players to enhance semiconductor production efficiency.

regional_presence.China: The company collaborates with leading Chinese institutions and industry players like Huawei and ZTE, indicating a strong presence in the Chinese semiconductor market.
